text: Look at my brokerage account's current holdings and propose a trade: sell [amount or shares] of [ticker to sell] and buy [ticker to buy], with a short reason for each. Don't place any orders yet. Show me the exact order details, including quantity, order type, and estimated cost, and wait for my explicit approval before executing.
